objectives.statement: Recognize and use som to connect a noun with extra information about it.
Distinguish subject and object relative clauses and keep som when it is the subject.
Place sentence adverbs correctly inside relative clauses.
Use natural Norwegian preposition placement in relative clauses.

notes: Must teach som for people/things and both subject and object relative clauses. Include subordinate-clause adverb placement, especially som ikke er and som jeg kjøpte; preposition stranding in relative clauses; and that som cannot be omitted when it is the subject.
